title: Implement window deletion logic for splice
description: Implement window deletion at start index with two modes: default mode deletes windows up to start+delete (skipping non-existent), disjoint mode deletes next n existing windows.

title: Refactor subcommands into command/ directory
description: Move find-opencode, hsplit, and vsplit subcommands from cli.ts into separate files in a new command/ directory. Each command should be its own module with proper exports.

title: Refactor subcommands into their own command/ directory
description: Move subcommand implementations into a dedicated command/ directory to improve code organization and maintainability.

title: Add preflight checks for hsplit command
description: Add preflight checks to the hsplit command to verify the session is in a good state before splitting. Include optional arguments --check-win1 and --check-win2 to specify programs that should be running in windows 1 and 2 if they exist. Check that window 0 has opencode running.

title: Switch to using zx for CLI scripts
description: Replace current gunshi-based CLI with zx. Look up zx in context7 to understand the library and its best practices. Rewrite the cli.ts to use zx for better shell script capabilities and cleaner async/await patterns.
close_reason: Replaced all exec and execAsync calls with zx. Removed gunshi dependency.

title: Add splice command for tmux window management
description: Implement a splice command that can delete and insert tmux windows at a specific index, similar to array splicing.

title: Design splice command interface and argument parsing
description: Design the splice command interface with positional/named arguments for start, insert count, and delete count. Include short flags. Add name parameter that can be provided multiple times as alternative to insert count. Add disjoint flag option.

title: Add vsplit command
description: Create a vsplit command that creates vertical splits instead of horizontal splits. Similar to hsplit, the top pane should have opencode and the bottom pane should be window 2.

title: Add splice validation and error handling
description: Add validation for splice arguments (negative indices, invalid counts, non-existent windows). Provide clear error messages for invalid states.

title: Implement window insertion logic for splice
description: Implement window insertion at start index. Support inserting by count (empty windows) or by name list (existing windows to move). Handle edge cases and renumbering.
